SHCatalog.doc: An abstract base class for storing reference signatures and their associated metadata.

SHCustomCatalog.doc: An object for storing the reference signatures for custom audio recordings and their associated metadata.

SHMatch.doc: An object that represents the catalog media items that match a query.

SHMatchedMediaItem.doc: An object that represents the metadata for a matched reference signature.

SHMediaItem.doc: An object that represents the metadata for a reference signature.

SHMediaLibrary.doc: An object that represents the user’s Shazam library.

SHRange.doc: A half-open interval from a lower bound up to, but not including, an upper bound.

SHSession.doc: An object that matches a specific audio recording when a segment of that recording is part of captured sound in the Shazam catalog or your custom catalog.

SHSignature.doc: An object that contains the opaque data and other information for a signature.

SHSignatureGenerator.doc: An object for converting audio data into a signature.

SHSessionDelegate.doc: Methods that the session calls with the result of a match request.

SHErrorCode.doc: Codes for the errors that Shazam produces.

+new.doc: Creates a new custom catalog object for storing reference audio signatures and their associated metadata.

-addCustomCatalogFromURL:error:.doc: Loads a saved custom catalog from a file.

-addReferenceSignature:representingMedia.doc: Adds a reference signature and its associated metadata to a catalog.

-init.doc: Creates a new custom catalog object for storing reference audio signatures and their associated metadata.

-writeToURL:error:.doc: Saves the custom catalog to a local file.

+fetchMediaItemWithShazamID:completionHa.doc: Requests the media item for the song with the specified Shazam ID.

+mediaItemWithProperties:.doc: Creates a media item object with a dictionary of properties and their associated values.

-objectForKeyedSubscript:.doc: Accesses the property for the specified key for reading.

-valueForProperty:.doc: Accesses the property for the specified key for reading.

-addMediaItems:completionHandler:.doc: Adds an array of songs to the user’s Shazam library.

+rangeWithLowerBound:upperBound:.doc: Creates a range with the bounds you specify.

-initWithLowerBound:upperBound:.doc: Creates a range with the bounds you specify.

-init.doc: Creates a new session object for matching songs in the Shazam Music catalog.

-initWithCatalog:.doc: Creates a new session object for matching audio in a custom catalog.

-matchSignature:.doc: Searches for the query signature in the reference signatures that the session catalog contains.

-matchStreamingBuffer:atTime:.doc: Converts the audio in the buffer to a signature, and searches the reference signatures in the session catalog.

+signatureWithDataRepresentation:error:.doc: Creates a signature object from raw data.

-initWithDataRepresentation:error:.doc: Creates a signature object from raw data.

+generateSignatureFromAsset:completionHa.doc: Creates a signature with the asset you specify.

-signature.doc: Converts the audio buffer into a signature.

maximumQuerySignatureDuration.doc: The maximum duration of a query signature that you use to match reference signatures in the catalog.

minimumQuerySignatureDuration.doc: The minimum duration of a query signature that you use to match reference signatures in the catalog.

dataRepresentation.doc: The data representation of this file, it can be written to disk

mediaItems.doc: An array of the media items in the catalog that match the query signature, in order of the quality of the match.

querySignature.doc: The query signature for the match.

confidence.doc: The level of confidence in the match result.

frequencySkew.doc: A multiple for the difference in frequency between the matched audio and the query audio.

matchOffset.doc: The timecode in the reference recording that matches the start of the query, in seconds.

predictedCurrentMatchOffset.doc: The updated timecode in the reference recording that matches the current playback position of the query audio, in seconds.

appleMusicID.doc: The Apple Music ID for the song.

appleMusicURL.doc: A link to the Apple Music page that contains the full information for the song.

artist.doc: The name of the artist for the media item, such as the performer of a song.

artworkURL.doc: The URL for artwork for the media item, such as an album cover.

creationDate.doc: The date the media item was created.

explicitContent.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the media item contains explicit content.

frequencySkewRanges.doc: An array of ranges that indicate the frequency skews in the reference signature that this media item describes.

genres.doc: An array of genre names for the media item.

id.doc: A unique identifier for this media item.

init(properties:).doc: Creates a media item object with a dictionary of properties and their associated values.

isrc.doc: The International Standard Recording Code (ISRC) for the media item.

shazamID.doc: The Shazam ID for the song.

songs.doc: An array of MusicKit song objects that represent the song.

songs().doc: An array of MusicKit song objects that represent the media item.

subtitle.doc: A subtitle for the media item.

timeRanges.doc: An array of ranges that indicate the offsets within the reference signature that this media item describes.

title.doc: A title for the media item.

videoURL.doc: The URL for a video for the media item, such as a music video.

webURL.doc: A link to the Shazam Music catalog page that contains the full information for the song.

defaultLibrary.doc: An instance of the user’s default Shazam library.

SHSession.Result.doc: Identifies the result from an asynchronous sequence result.

SHSession.Results.doc: An asynchronous sequence that emits updates from a session object query.

catalog.doc: The catalog object containing the reference signatures and their associated metadata that the session uses to perform matches.

delegate.doc: The object that the session calls with the result of a match request.

result(from:).doc: Performs an asynchronous match with a signature you specify.

results.doc: The results as an asynchronous sequence of matches.

dataRepresentation.doc: The raw data for the signature.

duration.doc: The duration of the audio you use to generate the signature.

slices(from:duration:stride:).doc: Returns a sequence of signatures of the specified duration from a starting value, stepping by the stride.
